Minimizing the squared error in a least squares problem is mathematically equivalent to minimizing the norm squared of the residual, i.e., minimizing $||Ax - b||^2$. The source confirms this equivalence by stating the problem is solved by finding the minimizing solution $x$ for $Ax=b$.
